title: Lesson 1
paragraph: コンピューターとデータ

words.meaning: programs that tell a computer what to do
words.example: You need to update the software before opening this file.

words.meaning: the physical parts of a computer system
words.example: The repair team checks the hardware for damage.

words.meaning: a program used to open and view websites
words.example: Open the link in your browser.

words.meaning: a computer or program that provides services to other computers
words.example: The server sends the requested page to your browser.

words.meaning: a group of connected devices that can exchange information
words.example: All the office computers use the same network.

words.meaning: an organized collection of information that a computer can search and update
words.example: We store customer addresses in a database.

words.meaning: a named collection of information stored on a computer
words.example: Save the document as a new file.

words.meaning: a place used to group files on a computer
words.example: Put the photos in a separate folder.

words.meaning: an extra copy of data kept in case the original is lost
words.example: Make a backup before you replace the computer.

sentencePractice.prompt: Keep an extra copy of the data in case the original is lost. This extra copy is a ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: The defined role is a recoverable copy of data, not software for viewing sites or connected devices.

words.meaning: space or equipment used to keep digital information
words.japaneseMeaning: 記憶領域・ストレージ
words.example: The device has enough storage for all our videos.
